quotes.text: Eliminating unfair MSP premiums is the biggest middle-class tax cuts in BC history, saving families up to $1,800 a year.
quotes.speaker: BC NDP

quotes.text: We’ve fixed restrictive and outdated rules that were blocking townhouses, row homes and duplexes.
quotes.speaker: BC NDP

quotes.locator: Connecting people to care now with new clinics and networks
quotes.text: We've opened 39 Urgent and Primary Care Clinics since 2018, and set up 77 Primary Care Networks, with more to come.

quotes.text: Cut childcare costs in half on average (saving families up to $900/month per child)
quotes.speaker: BC NDP

quotes.text: We’ve made it so you can now take 5 paid sick days a year under minimum employment standards.
quotes.speaker: BC NDP

quotes.text: We’re keeping repeat violent offenders off the street with stricter bail rules and stronger enforcement.

quotes.text: We invested $500 million this year to cap ferry fare increases for the next four years.
quotes.speaker: BC NDP

quotes.text: Prescription birth control is now free in BC, saving nearly 300,000 people about $300 a year and supporting people to make choices about their reproductive health.

quotes.text: CentreBC believes in responsible financial management—balancing the budget over the long term through smarter investments and spending.
quotes.speaker: CentreBC

quotes.text: We remain committed to protecting the health care, education, and social supports that British Columbians depend on, while ensuring every tax dollar delivers real results.

quotes.text: Accessible, well-funded healthcare and mental health supports.
